24271-children-s-rhymes-children-s-games.title: A Book for Bairns and Big Folk
24271-children-s-rhymes-children-s-games.creator: Robert Ford
24271-children-s-rhymes-children-s-games.description: A book by Robert Ford. l welcome, alike from old and young. It is the first really sincere effort to collect in anything like ample and exclusive fashion the _natural literature_ of the children of Scotland, and meets what has long appealed to me as decidedly a felt want. The earlier pages are occupied with a commentary, textually illustrated, on the generally puerile, but regularly fascinating Rhymes of the Nursery, the vitality and universal use of which have been at once the wonder and the puzzle of the ages.

42330-some-verses.title: Some Verses
42330-some-verses.creator: Unknown
42330-some-verses.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. And shall it be that these undaunted snows  That poise so lightly on the mountains' crest--  A lily laid to cheer its lonely breast--  Shall their chill smile still face the wind, that blows  Across the field whereon no blossom grows,  And light the land where no gay life may rest  Save glowing hasty fingers of the West,  When our two hearts lie cold beneath the rose?

63198-lords-of-creation-woman-suffrage-d.title: Three Acts.
63198-lords-of-creation-woman-suffrage-d.creator: Ella Cheever Thayer.
63198-lords-of-creation-woman-suffrage-d.description: A book by Ella Cheever Thayer.. All a body has to do is to wait on him, that is what _he_ thinks! For he is a lord of creation, he is! And he must have his buttonhole bouquet, and his hair parted in the middle, and his mustache waxed, and everybody must bow down and worship him! But after all, he isn't as bad as his father. isn't _he_ just awful!

70715-to-mesopotamia-and-kurdistan-in-di.creator: Unknown
70715-to-mesopotamia-and-kurdistan-in-di.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. This information, then, I think is unique. arxiv-2104-04683.title: A Low-Cost Attack against the hCaptcha System
arxiv-2104-04683.creator: Md Imran Hossen, Xiali Hei
arxiv-2104-04683.description: Abstract CAPTCHAs are a defense mechanism to prevent malicious bot programs from abusing websites on the Internet. hCaptcha is a relatively new but emerging image CAPTCHA service. This paper presents an automated system that can break hCaptcha challenges with a high success rate.

arxiv-2110-05687.title: RWN: Robust Watermarking Network for Image Cropping Localization Thanks: This work is supported by National Natural Science Foundation of China under Grant U20B2051, U1936214. Qichao Ying and Xiaoxiao Hu contribute equally. ⋆ Corresponding author: Zhenxing Qian (zxqian@fudan.edu.cn). We are grateful
arxiv-2110-05687.creator: Qichao Ying, Xiaoxiao Hu, Xiangyu Zhang, Sheng Li, Zhenxing Qian ⋆, Xinpeng Zhang
arxiv-2110-05687.description: Abstract Image cropping can be maliciously used to manipulate the layout of an image and alter the underlying meaning. Previous image crop detection schemes only predicts whether an image has been cropped, ignoring which part of the image is cropped. This paper presents a novel robust watermarking network (RWN) for image crop localization.

arxiv-2210-16147.title: Modeling structure-building in the brain with CCG parsing and large language models
arxiv-2210-16147.creator: Miloš Stanojević, Jonathan R. Brennan, Donald Dunagan, Mark Steedman, John T. Hale
arxiv-2210-16147.description: Abstract To model behavioral and neural correlates of language comprehension in naturalistic environments researchers have turned to broad-coverage tools from natural-language processing and machine learning. Where syntactic structure is explicitly modeled, prior work has relied predominantly on context-free grammars (CFG), yet such formalisms are not sufficiently expressive for human languages.

arxiv-2308-06629.title: Optimal FIFO grouping in public transit networks
arxiv-2308-06629.creator: Steil, Patrick
arxiv-2308-06629.description: Abstract 1 Introduction This technical report is about grouping public transit vehicles ( trips ) into a set of routes (or, as they are more commonly known: lines ) so that two vehicles of the same route do not overtake each other. We say that such a set of routes satisfies the FIFO property.

arxiv-2405-10996.title: Optimization with Temporal and Logical Specifications via Generalized Mean-based Smooth Robustness Measures ​​​​ footnoteinfo
arxiv-2405-10996.creator: Samet Uzun, Purnanand Elango, Pierre-Loïc Garoche, Behçet Açıkmeşe
arxiv-2405-10996.description: Abstract This paper introduces a generalized mean-based 𝒞 1 \mathcal{C}^{1} -smooth robustness measure over discrete-time signals (D-GMSR) for signal temporal logic (STL) specifications. In conjunction with its 𝒞 1 \mathcal{C}^{1} -smoothness, D-GMSR is proven to be both sound and complete . Furthermore, it demonstrates favorable gradient properties and addresses locality and masking problems, which are critical for numerical optimization.

arxiv-2503-14115.title: Efficient Greedy Discrete Subtrajectory Clustering
arxiv-2503-14115.creator: Ivor van der Hoog, Lara Ost, Eva Rotenberg, Daniel Rutschmann
arxiv-2503-14115.description: A 2025 arXiv research paper by Ivor van der Hoog, Lara Ost, Eva Rotenberg, Daniel Rutschmann. We cluster a set of trajectories 𝒯 \mathcal{T} using subtrajectories of 𝒯 \mathcal{T} . We require for a clustering C C that any two subtrajectories ( 𝒯 ⁡ [ a , b ] , 𝒯 ⁡ [ c , d ] ) (\mathcal{T}[a,b],\mathcal{T}[c,d]) in a cluster have disjoint intervals [ a , b ] [a,b] and [ c , d ] [c,d] .

arxiv-2506-09664.title: Early and Accurate Recession Detection Using Classifiers on the Anticipation-Precision Frontier
arxiv-2506-09664.creator: Pascal Michaillat
arxiv-2506-09664.description: Abstract This paper develops a new method for detecting US recessions in real time. The method constructs millions of recession classifiers by combining unemployment and vacancy data to reduce detection noise. Classifiers are then selected to avoid both false negatives (missed recessions) and false positives (nonexistent recessions).

arxiv-2510-01272.title: Modeling Others’ Minds as Code
arxiv-2510-01272.creator: Kunal Jha, Aydan Yuenan Huang, Eric Ye, Natasha Jaques & Max Kleiman-Weiner
arxiv-2510-01272.description: Abstract Accurate prediction of human behavior is essential for robust and safe human-AI collaboration. However, existing approaches for modeling people are often data-hungry and brittle because they either make unrealistic assumptions about rationality or are too computationally demanding to adapt rapidly.

arxiv-2602-18885.title: Learning Adaptive Perturbation-Conditioned Contexts for Robust Transcriptional Response Prediction
arxiv-2602-18885.creator: Yinhua Piao, Hyomin Kim, Seonghwan Kim, Yunhak Oh, Junhyeok Jeon, Sang-Yeon Hwang, Jaechang Lim, Woo Youn Kim, Chanyoung Park, Sungsoo Ahn
arxiv-2602-18885.description: Abstract Predicting high-dimensional transcriptional responses to genetic perturbations is challenging due to severe experimental noise and sparse gene-level effects. Existing methods often suffer from mean collapse , where high correlation is achieved by predicting global average expression rather than perturbation-specific responses, leading to many false positives and limited biological interpretability.

britannica-1911-tadpole.title: Tadpole (1911 Encyclopaedia Britannica article)
britannica-1911-tadpole.creator: Encyclopaedia Britannica
britannica-1911-tadpole.description: Article 'Tadpole' from the 1911 Encyclopædia Britannica (Volume 26), the classic English-language general encyclopedia, now in the public domain. to all Batrachian larvae. It is absurd to call the larva of a newt or of a Caecilian a tadpole, nor is the free-swimming embryo of a frog as it leaves the egg a tadpole. A tadpole is the larva of a tailless Batrachian after the loss of the external gills and before the egress of the fore limbs (except in the aberrant Xenopus) and the resorption of the tail.

pmc-10743682.title: Lights and Shadows of Clinical Applications of Cardiac Scintigraphy with Bone Tracers in Suspected Amyloidosis
pmc-10743682.creator: Riccardo Saro, Daniela Pavan, Aldostefano Porcari, Gianfranco Sinagra, Marco Mojoli, Firat Duru, Andrea Baggiano
pmc-10743682.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2023). Radionuclide bone scintigraphy is the cornerstone of an imaging-based algorithm for accurate non-invasive diagnosis of transthyretin cardiac amyloidosis (ATTR-CA). In patients with heart failure and suggestive echocardiographic and/or cardiac magnetic resonance imaging findings, the positive predictive value of Perugini grade 2 or 3 myocardial uptake on a radionuclide bone scan approaches 100% for the diagnosis of ATTR-CA as long as there is no biochemical evidence of a clonal dyscrasia.

pmc-11491674.title: Impact of butyric acid modification on the structural and functional properties of rice starch
pmc-11491674.creator: Qiaoyan Wu, Yang Yang, Yue Xu, Bing Wang, Xiaofei Liu, Yan Wang, Guang Zhang, Xin Bian, Chunmin Ma, Na Zhang
pmc-11491674.description: Rice is a food with a high starch content, comprising over 75% of its composition. However, prolonged and excessive consumption of this cereal may lead to elevated blood glucose levels, which can increase the risk of obesity, type 2 diabetes, and cardiovascular disease.

pmc-12499747.title: Supervised Machine Learning Models Predicting Postoperative Low Cardiac Output Syndrome In Neonates
pmc-12499747.creator: Orkun Baloglu, Xiaofeng Wang, Bradley S. Marino, Ayse Morca, Izzet T. Akbasli, Samir Q. Latifi, Alex Klaben, Animesh Tandon
pmc-12499747.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). OBJECTIVE:To train and test supervised machine learning (ML) models to predict low cardiac output syndrome (LCOS) within the first 48 postoperative hours in neonates undergoing cardiothoracic surgery.DESIGN:Retrospective observational study. An efficient tree-based gradient-boosting algorithm (LightGBM) ML models were developed to predict LCOS occurrence at 2-, 4-, 6-, and 12-hour forecasting horizons, incorporating data from the prediction time and the two preceding hours.

pmc-12583440.title: Kinematic modeling of musculoskeletal systems considering muscle inertia for monoarticular muscles
pmc-12583440.creator: A. Parsian, M. H. Korayem, F. Allahverdi
pmc-12583440.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Understanding human musculoskeletal dynamics is the key to further advancement in both biomedical engineering and humanoid robotics. Numerical models today have certain setbacks that hinder the accuracy of analyses, especially in orthopedic surgery and robotic design. A kinematic behavior-based analytical model of musculoskeletal systems is presented that explores muscle inertia and center of mass (COM) variations across six configurations and modes. This model incorporates long and asymmetric tendons, along with a dynamically reducing joint radius relative to the joint angle.

pmc-12648329.title: A Charge Transfer Mediated Sequential Triplet Energy Transfer Model Beyond the Dexter Limit in Organic Photocatalysis
pmc-12648329.creator: Lin Liu, Yibo Shi, Jialong Jie, Xiao Liu, Qian Wang, Yu Qiao, Kai Feng, Weihai Fang, Hongmei Su, Xuebo Chen
pmc-12648329.description: Classical distance-dependent Dexter energy transfer models fail to account for the complex, geometry-sensitive kinetics observed in flexible and dynamically disordered organic photocatalytic systems. To resolve these persistent inconsistencies, particularly in photosensitized [2 + 2] cycloaddition reactions, we investigate how charge-transfer (CT) intermediates mediate triplet–triplet energy transfer (TTEnT) beyond the conventional Dexter framework.

pmc-12739146.title: Adenoviral vector oropharyngeal spray immunization elicits mucosal immunity and protects against heterologous SARS-CoV-2 infection
pmc-12739146.creator: Gerrit Koopman, Petra Mooij, Maria Gaudino, Roja Fidel Acar, Pascal Irrgang, Alina Russ, Dafne Blankenstein, Zahra Fagrouch, Daniella Mortier, Kinga P Böszörményi, Edmond J Remarque, Willy M Bogers, Ernst J Verschoor, Thomas Gramberg, Matthias Tenbusch
pmc-12739146.description: Mucosal immunity may be required to prevent the ongoing transmission of SARS-CoV-2 emerging variants of concern. To define the most efficient way to induce protective mucosal immunity, we compared three different forms of mucosal antigen exposure in mRNA pre-immunized rhesus macaques. Two vaccine groups received an oropharyngeal spray immunization with either an adenoviral vector or a live-attenuated SARS-CoV-2 vaccine (LAV).

pmc-13456776.title: Different results with early single-stage and staged repair in infants with ileal atresia: a two-case report on the effect of timing and treatment approach
pmc-13456776.creator: Layth J.M. Saada, Jamil Saada
pmc-13456776.description: Introduction and importance:Ileal atresia represents a major cause of newborn intestinal obstruction, requiring prompt surgical correction. Although a preferred procedure is the primary anastomosis in stable patients, the timing and surgical procedure can play a pivotal role in affecting morbidity, nutritional state, and the course of hospitalization. This article highlights the importance of these factors.

pmc-13524873.title: Kinetics, thermodynamics, and mechanisms of PMO interactions from computational molecular modeling
pmc-13524873.creator: Ying Chou, Igor Novikov, Daniel Pierson, Kenneth A. Marx, Arani Chanda, Valeri Barsegov
pmc-13524873.description: Phosphorodiamidate morpholino oligonucleotides (PMOs) are a class of antisense oligonucleotides. While PMOs have enabled several nucleic acid therapeutics, their structural and energetic solution properties remain poorly understood. Using solution viscosity measurements combined with computational molecular modeling, we explored interactions of therapeutic 22-mer, 25-mer, and 30-mer PMOs in concentrated solutions.
